patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient has been experiencing progressive left leg pain for 2 months, with recent interference with sleep. The pain was initially treated as 'growing pains' with ibuprofen, without improvement. He recalls being hit in the thigh by a baseball one week before the onset of symptoms, resulting in redness and swelling that lasted several days.

Secondary_Symptoms: History of trauma to the leg

patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: No fever, weight loss, or other systemic symptoms reported.

objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and diagnose the patient presenting with progressive left leg pain and assess the pathological causes.

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

“My left leg has been hurting for about two months, and it’s getting worse—it even keeps me up at night. It started after I got hit on the thigh by a baseball, and my thigh was red and swollen for a few days after.”

“No, I don’t think so—I haven’t noticed my leg getting cold or numb, or any color change in my foot. Mostly it’s just a deep pain in my left thigh that’s been getting worse and keeps me from sleeping.”
[ASK] Do you have a new, painful shoulder with limited range of motion (difficulty raising the arm)?
“No, I don’t have any shoulder pain or trouble raising my arm. It’s only been my left thigh pain that’s getting worse and disrupting my sleep.”
“I’ve never been told I have Ewing sarcoma, and I don’t have any fever or weight loss—I just have the deep left thigh pain that’s been getting worse and bothering my sleep.”
“No, I haven’t had any psoriasis patches, skin flaking, or joint swelling in other areas—this has mainly been the deep pain in my left thigh that’s getting worse.”

“No, I’m not having fever, weight loss, or anything like that, and no one has said I have Ewing sarcoma. It’s just the deep, progressive pain in my left thigh since the baseball hit, and it’s been getting worse and keeping me up at night.”

“No, I don’t have any fever or weight loss, and nobody has mentioned Ewing sarcoma. It’s still mainly the deep, worsening pain in my left thigh that started after the baseball hit and now disrupts my sleep.”
[DDX] Acalculous cholecystitis, Actinic Keratosis, Autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease  , Bacillus cereus infection, Brief Psychotic Disorder
